name: Aina Inori
source:
Grade: 1st year, Yuzuki Group

The cute kouhai character in the story. She’s cute, but communication-wise she isn’t exactly top class and therefore she’s a little lonely because she thinks she doesn’t have friends. She supports [url=/c13085]Akira[/url] a lot in the story.

[Edited from [url=http://accany.wordpress.com/2009/05/31/花と乙女に祝福を-review/]Accany's review[/url]]
